source: Copernicus Sentinel-2 L2A COGs via Earth Search
bounded_access: Per-asset rasterio COG range reads for only a projected bounding window enclosing eight reviewed point crops; no full scene downloads.

native_analysis_grid.pixel_support: 20 m square; B04/B08 bilinear resampled from native 10 m; B11/SCL native 20 m; all metrics on common 20 m grid

selected_scenes.mask: SCL classes 4,5,6 (vegetation, bare soil, water) retained; unclassified, cloud shadow, clouds, cirrus, snow, saturation, dark pixels and no-data excluded from NDVI/NDMI
selected_scenes.indices: NDVI=(B08-B04)/(B08+B04); NDMI=(B08-B11)/(B08+B11), after scale/offset; no RGB-derived indices
